reviewer: Codex /root; same-context mathematical self-review, not independent human or theorem review
conditional_scope: Formula/specification review only; no empirical assumption, originality, GPU interface or efficacy verified.

formal_object.rationale: Frozen direct-coordinate decoder F_t(x)=F(z,x,a,t) in R^3; anchor x in R^3. F_a need not equal x. The stated object/domain, rather than the official unsquared Chamfer, is the object of this conditional derivation.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: H01: F_t(x)+b(x) for all t -> Differences F_t-F_a are invariant to b; condition: The nuisance field b is shared over target times; C04: Errors e_t=F_t-Y_t and e_a=F_a-x -> Correction error is e_t-e_a; condition: Finite second moments; shared vertex identity All current edges remain conditional where model/data availability is not established.

derivation.rationale: Substitution gives H_a=x and cancels a target-time-shared additive field. The full squared-risk expansion keeps E[e_t^T e_a]; improvement requires a positive cross term exceeding half the self-error power. This is not an unsquared Chamfer or CD-M inequality. Direct-coordinate semantics are matched to the pinned decoder.

assumptions.rationale: Conditional validity requires: The decoder is evaluated on the same anchor query and context.; The common-bias explanation is conditional, not diagnosed by the 16 published scores.; A boundary identity is not a bound on CD-M; corrected points may leave [-1,1].; Do not silently clip the correction: clipping changes its algebra and requires a separate constraint/record. These are obligations, not observations about ActionBench.

method_expression.rationale: Query F_a once and F_t for each original t; output H_t=x+F_t-F_a. Preserve faces and all time IDs. The reviewed construction is Pointwise deterministic self-map quotient, no covariance estimate, transport or temporal regularizer.. This is a specification, not an implemented method.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The construction predicts: The correction should help when self-map error positively predicts downstream error strongly enough to exceed half its own squared magnitude; zero self-map residual gives no change. It can be rejected by: Reject the common-bias explanation if actual self-map residuals do not predict the downstream error and the method loses to equal-call uncorrected/bias-fit controls on fresh native cases. This contrast is specified before any new-method experiment.

closest_alternative.rationale: Named alternatives: Uncorrected ActionMesh; simple mean-bias correction; SFG already anchors latent sampling trajectories by initial shape plus differences (Eq.2). Historical m02 checks decoder cycles, not this shared-bias risk criterion. The decoded-coordinate variant is a diagnostic/baseline until a material functional delta is established. Claimed operational difference: Exact boundary and nuisance-invariance consequence; novelty beyond existing boundary correction remains pending. This check verifies an explicit comparator and conditional delta, not completed novelty clearance.
